name: HexHub Importer
description: 从 HexHub 客户端导出的 HexHub-Assets.json 中读取 SSH 会话、数据库与 Redis 连接以及快捷命令，并通过 Rust WASM 导入到 Navop；导出文件里的口令与私钥用客户端内置的固定密钥加密，可离线解密后一并迁移，覆盖本地迁移与离线导入场景。 Reads SSH sessions, database and Redis connections, and quick commands from a HexHub asset export (HexHub-Assets.json) and imports them into Navop through Rust WASM. Passwords and private keys are protected with the client's built-in fixed key, so they are decrypted offline and migrated together, covering local migration and offline import workflows.

connectionImporters.description: 从 HexHub 导出的 HexHub-Assets.json 中发现并导入 SSH 会话、数据库与 Redis 连接及快捷命令。 Discover and import SSH sessions, database and Redis connections, and quick commands from a HexHub asset export.

manualFilePick.prompt: 选择 HexHub 导出的 HexHub-Assets.json 文件（HexHub：资产 → 导出，不要设置加密密码）
